 General Hospital Recap: Everyone’s Coming for Sonny and Jude’s Secret Accomplice is Revealed!
 By Michelle Parkerton 
 November 20, 2026 
 Comments 
 ABC 
 Tap Here To Add Soap Opera Digest As A Trusted Source 
 Add as a preferred source on Google 
 On General Hospital on Friday, November 20, Sonny ( Maurice Benard ) and Ava ( Maura West ) faced off over the shooting on the pier, Drew ( Cameron Mathison ) and Curtis ( Donnell Turner ) teamed up to take down Sonny, Josslyn ( Eden McCoy ) officially incriminated Sonny to the PCPD, Anna ( Finola Hughes ) agreed to return to work as police commissioner, Jude’s (Wil Traval) secret ally was revealed, and much more! Keep on reading for all the details.
 Shooting Scars 
 After learning that Avery was at the hospital, Carly rushed out of Sonny’s house. Chase tried to stop Sonny from leaving, but backed down from questioning the worried father when Ric intervened.
 Over at G.H., Elizabeth called Ava while Dante got Avery’s side of what happened at the pier. Carly got to the hospital moments before Ava and Drew. Ava went to see Avery, Carly got an update from Felicia, and Dante thanked Elizabeth for the care she took with his sister. Drew made a jab about Sonny’s part in the shooting, and Dante exited rather than engage.
 As Ava consoled her traumatized daughter, Sonny and Ric arrived, and Drew immediately confronted Sonny. Ava ran out to the hub and slapped Sonny, accusing him of nearly getting their daughter killed. Despite Sonny’s insistence that he had nothing to do with it, the argument escalated.
 Fight Club: Ric (Rick Hearst, l.) and Liz (Rebecca Herbst, c.) tried to keep the argument between Sonny (Maurice Benard, far l.), Drew (Cameron Mathison) and Ava (Maura West) from escalating. ABC 
 Liz managed to defuse the situation, but Ava hissed that she’d never let Sonny near their daughter ever again. Sonny agreed to leave but warned he wouldn’t allow Ava to keep him from Avery. Later, Liz sighed to Felicia that if Sonny really were to blame, it would be Dante’s worst nightmare come true.
 Related 
 GH's Dominic Zamprogna: Rebecca Herbst 'Speaks My Acting Love Language' (Excl) 
 After years of barely sharing scenes, General Hospital stars Dominic Zamprogna (Dante Falconeri) and Rebecca Herbst (Elizabeth) began working together earlier this year as the show started to test the waters of a Dante and Liz pairing — and as their characters’ connection deepens, so too has Zamprogna’s admiration for Herbst. “She’s wonderful,” he tells Soap Opera […] 
 Sins of the Fathers 
 Jude introduced himself to Anna and apologized for what she’d gone through when Jerry made her believe Robin was dead. Anna hoped Jude would prove he wasn’t like his father, and he appreciated that she showed him more grace than some others had.
 First Impressions: Anna (Finola Hughes) hoped Jude (Wil Traval) wasn’t a chip off the old block. ABC 
 Jude chuckled that one reason he was in town was to deal with Josslyn, who was out of her depth running JJE. Anna wondered if he knew his cousin well enough to make that assumption.
 Back at the hospital, Carly noticed Avery eavesdropping on the hubbub involving her parents and quickly brought her back to her room. When Avery questioned if Josslyn had been telling the truth about her dad, Carly assured Avery that Sonny had nothing to do with what happened.
 Here for You: Carly (Laura Wright, l.) tried to reassure Avery (Ayla Bullingon). ABC 
 Wait and See 
 Portia was not happy when she and Isaiah arrived at the house to find Curtis holding Desmond. Curtis was dismissive of Isaiah, who stood up for himself, and Portia set boundaries with Curtis about future visits.
 Once Trina, Kai, and Curtis left, an anxious Portia wanted to hire a lawyer. Isaiah thought Curtis would focus on Heather being in town and Trina’s stalker (once he learned about those things), so they should hold off on making any preemptive moves with Dez. Isaiah vowed he wouldn’t let Curtis push him out of Portia or Desmond’s lives.
 Take a Breath: Isaiah (Sawandi Wilson) urged Portia (Brook Kerr) not to do anything drastic. ABC 
 Public Enemy 
 Across town, Trina, Kai, and Curtis were about to enter Bobbie’s when Trina received a call from Josslyn. Concerned that the apartment wouldn’t be safe in the aftermath of the shooting, Josslyn encouraged Trina to sleep someplace else for a few nights.
 Fed up with the apparent violence at Sonny’s hand, Curtis tracked Drew down at the hospital and pitched using Aurora’s network to bury Sonny in the media. An eager Drew proposed they work together to get rid of their common enemy, and the men shook on their deal.
 Team Effort: Drew wanted Curtis (Donnell Turner) to help him take down Sonny. ABC 
 Back at Bobbie’s, Kai invited Trina to stay at his place, promising to protect her, and she realized that she needed to tell her father about the stalker now that he was out of prison. As they talked, Trina’s stalker spied on them from outside the diner.
 Related 
 GHs Cameron Mathison Says Drew Could 'Absolutely' Fall For Ava 
 Drew Cain (Cameron Mathison) and Ava Jerome (Maura West) became the latest General Hospital duo to enter into a marriage of convenience when they tied the knot so they can’t be forced to testify against each other for their crimes against the late Jack Brennan (Chris McKenna). But could the union between these partners in crime […] 
 Return To Office 
 At the PCPD, Josslyn joined Hudson as he gave his statement to Justine, who was determined to put Sonny away for good. Both Justine and Josslyn were impressed by Hudson’s level of detail, the result of his training at the U.S. Air Force Academy.
 Alone with Hudson, Josslyn asked about his time in the military, since he never spoke about it, and wondered what else he hadn’t told her about his past.
 Hidden Depths: Hudson’s (Troy Lennon Appel) statement to Justine (Nazneen Contractor, r.) made Josslyn (Eden McCoy) wonder what other secrets he was hiding. ABC 
 When Dante returned to the station, Justine informed him of Sonny’s potential involvement and told Dante that after he took Josslyn’s official statement, she was removing him from the case since it was a conflict of interest. Chase arrived and reported that Sonny refused to come in for questioning.
 Dante took the rest of Josslyn’s statement, and she went on the record that Sonny tried to kill her.
 Related 
 Opinion: Redeeming Dangerous Soap Villains is Tricky Business 
 There’s a big difference between a standard soap baddie and an irredeemable criminal. Our critic says General Hospital, The Young and the Restless, The Bold and the Beautiful, Beyond the Gates and Days of our Lives need to think twice before scripting crimes that makes true redemption impossible. Cobalt Blue A common mistake soaps make […] 
 Justine called Anna to the PCPD and explained the theory that Sonny was responsible for the shooting at Pier 55. She vowed to hold him accountable and wanted Anna back as commissioner to make sure that happened. Anna agreed to return to work.
 Back to Work: Justine convinced Anna to take back her job as police commissioner. ABC 
 Bad Feeling 
 Left alone while Drew and Ava were at the hospital, a freaked-out Scout invited Danny over to keep her company, not knowing he’d also been at the pier. Once Danny filled her in, the siblings worried Drew would see the incident as another reason to keep them apart. Danny also asked Scout to keep an eye on Avery for him, knowing that Avery had previously been sheltered from that kind of violence.
 From Bad to Worse: Danny (Asher Antonyzyn) told Scout (Kayden Brenna Tokarski) about the shooting. ABC 
 Partners In Crime ?
 At the Metro Court, a furious Hudson barged into Jude’s suite and accused Jude of trying to have Josslyn killed, putting him in the crossfire with two kids. “I did not sign up for this,” Hudson seethed.
 Too Far: Hudson didn’t appreciate what Jude had gotten him mixed up in. ABC 
 Related 
 GH: Who is Jude Jacks? Will Traval Teases What's Ahead 
 On the Thursday, October 29 episode of General Hospital, the mystery man played by Wil Traval finally introduced himself by name: Jude Jacks, the surprise son of notorious Port Charles baddie Jerry Jacks (Sebastian Roché) — and he claimed to be the biological father of Phoebe, who was recently adopted by Brook Lynn (Amanda Setton) and […] 
 Should Carly have been honest with Avery? What did you make of the reveal about Hudson and Jude? Share your thoughts about the latest episode of GH in the comments below!
